# Additional hand-written cases

| Case | Input | Catches |
| --- | --- | --- |
| X1 | Long leading-zero price and timestamp | Long leading-zero price and timestamp |
| X2 | Quoted duplicate click is idempotent | Quoted duplicate click is idempotent |
| X3 | Misplaced quotes in every input stream | Misplaced quotes in every input stream |
| X4 | Long full-byte IDs with common prefixes | Long full-byte IDs with common prefixes |
| X5 | Unterminated final record in each stream | Unterminated final record in each stream |
| X6 | Leap day and offset across midnight | Leap day and offset across midnight |
| X7 | Invalid earliest copy has a different user | Invalid earliest copy has a different user |
| X8 | Unused uppercase alias supplies component minimum | Unused uppercase alias supplies component minimum |
| X9 | Quoted empty in every event, click and link column | Quoted empty in every event, click and link column |
| X10 | Blank record before earlier duplicate | Blank record before earlier duplicate |
| X11 | Lexical click tie k10 precedes k9 | Lexical click tie k10 precedes k9 |
| X12 | Unknown category can win or lose a lexical tie | Unknown category can win or lose a lexical tie |
| X13 | Empty and header-only files | Empty and header-only files |
| X14 | Both encodings of empty click ID | Both encodings of empty click ID |
